subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Should changed Codex refreshes run this synchronous shadow phase as an intermediate production step, or should shadow execution remain gated until the safety and performance follow-ups can land with it?
rationale: The implementation intentionally preserves authoritative totals, but accepting its potentially multi-minute incremental refresh cost before the rest of the stack lands is a repository landing-policy choice rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Gate or combine shadow execution
options.body: Merge the foundation first, then land shadow execution only with an opt-in gate or alongside the safety and performance slices plus exact-head runtime proof.

options.title: Accept the intermediate overhead
options.body: Merge the stack sequentially while explicitly accepting slower changed-corpus refreshes until the subsequent optimization PR lands.

options.title: Reshape the stacked series
options.body: Ask for the runtime integration, safety controls, and performance validation to be consolidated into a smaller atomic landing unit.

recommendation.title: Gate or combine shadow execution
recommendation.body: Merge the foundation first, then land shadow execution only with an opt-in gate or alongside the safety and performance slices plus exact-head runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently carried the relevant scanner fixes and are the strongest available owner for the repository-level runtime tradeoff.
